title: Bit Positions in an Encoded Pair
statement: If $x=\langle q,\mathrm{serialize}(\varphi)\rangle$, then for every natural number $j$, the bit at position $j$ of $x$ (taking out-of-range positions to be false) is $q_{\lfloor j/2\rfloor}$ when $j<2|q|$, is false when $j=2|q|$, is true when $j=2|q|+1$, and otherwise is the bit of $\mathrm{serialize}(\varphi)$ at position $j-2|q|-2$, again taking out-of-range positions to be false.
hypotheses_covered: x equals the pair encoding of q and the serialization of φ
